name: The Siege of Blackford Keep
description: Lord Blackford's family has held this keep and guarded this stretch of the border for three generations. Since his son was killed in a raid two years ago, Blackford has been burning villages outside his own lands on suspicion of hiding raiders. The Crown ordered him to stand down and answer for it. He sealed his gates instead, and the Crown's soldiers who tried the keep first did not come back. The guild is going in next.
epilogue: Lord Blackford is dead and his keep is back in the Crown's hands. The King's investigators have their answers: a grieving man who stopped telling the difference between raiders and the people he was supposed to protect. The border villages are safe from him now.
title: Siegebreaker

name: The Frozen Wyrmkeep
description: High in the mountain passes above the Reach, a single dragon has become an entire brood: hatchlings, grown wyrms, and the ancient matriarch who started it, the Frozen Wyrm. For years, a group of locals has kept the nest hidden and fed rather than risk provoking it, and that has let the brood grow far too large. It will not stay in the mountains much longer. The guild is going up to end it first.
epilogue: The brood is gone and the ice is already covering what is left of the nest. The keepers have been brought down the mountain to answer for hiding it. Nobody will write songs about a mountain that simply stopped being dangerous, but the towns below sleep better.
title: Wyrmbrood's Bane

name: The Bonewrought Vault
description: An old royal treasury vault in the Reach has woken up. Its dead guards, buried in the walls to keep watch forever, are on their feet and guarding it again, raised by the same spreading undeath behind the empty graves in the culled villages. IronRest has lost three scouting parties trying to reach the vault-keeper at its heart, the construct that controls the guards. This time the guild is going in with everyone it has.
epilogue: The vault-keeper is destroyed and the guards have gone still again. Whatever raised them is still out there, still raising the dead across the Reach, and clearing one vault has not slowed it down.
title: Vault-Breaker

name: What Got Out
description: The demon lord who held the fortress is dead and its wards are down, but the ruin did not stay empty. A council of his surviving lieutenants has gathered there to finish a working he started: a breach between this world and wherever the demons come from, bigger than any of the old wounds they normally slip through. IronRest's scouts say at least one presence inside answers to none of the demons. If the breach opens, it will not stay inside the fortress. The guild has to get there first.
epilogue: The breach is closed before it finished opening, and the council scattered when the guild broke through. The fortress is empty again. Nobody expects it to stay that way.
title: Breach-Sealer

name: The Black Dragon Nest
description: A stretch of the eastern ridge has gone black with soot and emptied of farmers. A black dragon called the Brood Mother has nested there with a fresh clutch, guarded by keepers like the ones at the Wyrmkeep. Unlike that brood, this one is not staying put: farms along the ridge are already abandoned, and the Brood Mother is spreading her territory. The guild is going up to stop her.
epilogue: The nest is ash and broken shell, and the Brood Mother is dead. The ridge farms are being resettled. Why she chose that ridge in the first place is still unknown, and the guild is keeping an eye on it.
title: Nest-Breaker

name: The House of Bones
description: Ostrel the lich is in the ossuary the guild found, and he is not hiding. He has spent years sorting and storing the dead there for a ritual meant to contact something far older than himself. His phylactery keeps him alive while he works. He was halfway through the ritual when the guild's scouts found him, and he did not stop. The guild is going in to make sure he never finishes.
epilogue: Ostrel is dead, his phylactery smashed, and his ritual unfinished. Whatever he was trying to reach did not get through. Something was listening on the other end, though, and IronRest is treating this as a delay rather than an ending.
title: Marrow-Ender

name: Silence the Loom
description: The Loom is still under Millbrook, speaking through every person it has threaded, and every day it spreads to someone new. There are no guards in the way, only a long climb down to the thing itself, and it knows the guild is coming. It is not going to run. Millbrook cannot be freed while it is alive. The guild is going down to kill it.
epilogue: The Loom did not scream when it died. Its voices just stopped, one at a time, until nobody in Millbrook was speaking for it anymore. The threads are withering, and the town is slowly learning to disagree again. IronRest has sent healers and clergy to help.
title: Loom-Silencer

name: Requiem for the Last God
description: The road under the pilgrim archive has opened for the guild. At its end is the Last God, the god of the final mile, who once walked the dying peacefully into death. Nobody has made the pilgrimage in centuries, and the god has been starving ever since, still trying to perform a rite for people who never come. It is not evil. It just cannot do anything else anymore. The guild is going to do for the god what it used to do for everyone else: walk it home.
epilogue: The guild did not win this the way it has won other fights. It finished the last pilgrimage, for the god itself, because nobody else was left to do it. The Last God is at rest. The guild is still deciding what to call that.
title: Last Mile Walker
